latest.title: S3 Storage Classes Explained with Everyday Examples
latest.description:
While studying for the AWS Cloud Practitioner exam, I kept mixing up the S3 storage classes. The names all sounded alike. What finally helped was comparing each one to how I store things in real life, so here's my cheat sheet.
The main idea: every class keeps your data safe. They differ in how quickly you can get it back and how much you pay. Storage that's cheaper to keep usually costs more or takes longer to retrieve.
